purpose: Operational source-readiness map for behavioural-mechanism research. It ranks only the next admissible empirical action; it is not a ranking of economic importance, model truth, causal evidence or validation status.

mechanisms.next_admissible_action: Monitor future BNR policy-rate decisions only; open event-month MIR response values solely under the prospective confirmation contract after a non-zero event and official release.
blockers: No non-zero policy-rate event yet in the reserved prospective window.

mechanisms.next_admissible_action: Reopen only if an official/reproducible source supplies same-boundary opening principal and matched refinancing/reset rates across material debt blocks.
blockers: Opening principal, realized repriced principal, and matched old/new rates are not available on a reconciled public boundary.

mechanisms.next_admissible_action: Keep calibration closed. The matched BNR prudential source-discovery stage and the sole remaining BLS 2025-Q2 exact-source discovery stage are both frozen under the current public surface. Reopen the prudential path only on its declared new-official-evidence triggers. Reopen the BLS path only if BNR exposes an exact 2025-Q2 workbook endpoint or an exact official machine-readable time-series/catalog target with matching realised-round semantics.
blockers: The canonical realised BNR BLS panel now contains 11 exact observed rounds from 2022-Q4 through 2025-Q3; only 2025-Q2 remains missing.

Exact 2023-Q2, 2023-Q3 and 2024-Q2 workbooks are retained with hashes, all six preregistered observables are semantically mapped, and those three rounds are canonically promoted without interpolation.

For 2025-Q2 the official publication text is complete but rounded; the exact official workbook endpoint/bytes remain unretained. The current public discovery surface is exhausted for exact endpoint identity and is frozen until a declared new-official-evidence trigger; rounded publication values may not replace workbook-cell precision.

Official definitions reject direct CBD2-to-BNR substitution: BNR prudential indicators cover Romanian-legal-entity banks, while CBD2 sector 11 covers domestic banking groups/stand-alone banks under a consolidated domestic-control framework. A new matched source or exact BNR-table history is required.

The aggregate reduced form still mixes credit demand and supply, while NPL and capital ratios are endogenous prudential state variables; source completeness alone does not identify a bank-supply channel.
No NFC/household synthetic aggregation, interpolation, forward-fill, credit-equation estimation, model selection or holdout opening is authorized.

mechanisms.next_admissible_action: Do not open 2021-01..2026-06 final evaluation and do not respecify transforms, AR order, FX lag blocks, external-price lags, regime dummies or asymmetry on this evidence cycle. Reopen only through a separately preregistered cycle justified by genuinely new measurement or identification evidence, such as an exact Romania transaction-price import-price index, an independently justified exogenous FX-shock design, or new regime-identification evidence.
blockers: The preregistered FX candidate failed structural selection before holdout.
Incremental RMSE improvement over the mandatory external-price baseline was approximately 0.014%, below the preregistered 2% gate.
The FX candidate underperformed the AR(2)+seasonal baseline on RMSE and was slightly worse than the external-price baseline on MAE.
Positive cumulative FX sign consistency and good conditioning were insufficient to overcome the predictive-gain failures.
The 2021-01..2026-06 final-evaluation window remains unopened and cannot be used to rescue or respecify this cycle.

mechanisms.next_admissible_action: Do not open 2023-Q1..2026-Q1 final-evaluation performance and do not respecify on the same evidence cycle. Reopen sovereign-yield modelling only under a separately preregistered cycle triggered by genuinely new measurement or identification evidence, such as an exact retained domestic policy-rate vintage or an independently justified issuance/refinancing observable.
blockers: The preregistered fiscal-augmented common-market AR form failed structural selection before holdout.
Its RMSE was worse than both persistence and the common-market AR baseline.
The preregistered fiscal coefficient sign-consistency gates failed.
Post-result lag search, variable addition, sign changes or final-holdout inspection are prohibited in this cycle.

mechanisms.next_admissible_action: Keep household-consumption estimation closed. Reopen only if new official evidence satisfies one of three frozen triggers: (1) an observed Romania aggregate household burden measure aligned to S1M consumption, (2) an independently observed representativeness bridge from housing-loan borrowers to the aggregate consumption population, or (3) an observed housing-borrower consumption/income target under a separately preregistered mechanism. Screening now includes ECB HFCS, INS ABF/TEMPO, Eurostat HBS 2020 scientific-use microdata and ECB CES; none supplies the required Romania mortgage-borrower-to-S1M bridge. Do not replace it with owner-occupier status, cross-country transfer, synthetic weights or fit-selected proxies.
blockers: BNR publication text directly observes both new-loan and outstanding housing-loan DSTI levels for every quarter from 2023-Q1 through 2025-Q2.
The registered household-consumption target is aggregate QSA S1M (households plus NPISH), whereas BNR DSTI covers respondent-bank housing/mortgage-loan borrower portfolios.
A targeted official-source screening found no observed Romania bridge from the housing-loan borrower population to aggregate S1M consumption.
ECB HFCS is conceptually suitable and BNR is an HFCN member institution, but no Romania country dataset is identified in the 2017, 2021 or latest 2023 waves.
INS ABF/TEMPO supplies quarterly household budget/consumption aggregates, but no public mortgage-borrower-status breakdown or common DSTI-consumption linkage was identified.

Eurostat HBS 2020 scientific-use files include Romania household consumption, income and weights, but the released SUF manual identifies no mortgage/loan-status field; owner-occupier status is not an admissible borrower proxy.
ECB CES does not provide an identified Romania country series capable of closing this population boundary.
New-loan and outstanding-loan DSTI are definitionally distinct and may not be synthetically merged.
Selecting a mortgage, consumer-credit or synthetic weighted borrowing rate cannot repair the population mismatch and remains prohibited post hoc.
The registered macro DSR term remains unidentified; estimation and behavioural closure remain closed.

mechanisms.next_admissible_action: Do not open the 2024-Q1..2026-Q1 final-evaluation window and do not respecify lags, signs, predictors, target, rate family, interactions or regimes on this evidence cycle. Reopen only through a separately preregistered cycle triggered by genuinely new measurement or identification evidence.
blockers: The preregistered core lagged-driver investment-rate form failed structural selection before holdout.
Its RMSE was worse than both persistence and the estimated investment-rate AR benchmark.
The financing-rate coefficient violated the preregistered non-positive domain at every structural-selection origin (domain-consistency fraction 0.0).
The preregistered support-augmented extension also failed and did not improve on the core form.
The untouched 2024-Q1..2026-Q1 final-evaluation window may not be opened to rescue this cycle.

mechanisms.next_admissible_action: Keep credit-risk estimation closed. Reopen only through one of two explicit source paths: retain an aggregate Romania debt-service burden aligned to the exact aggregate NPL target, or retain exact machine-readable mortgage NPL plus housing-loan burden histories and preregister a new mortgage-specific target/form after reconciling reporting population, coverage and weighting. DTI-O may not substitute for debt service, BNR charts may not be digitised, and aggregate versus mortgage target may not be chosen after fit.
blockers: The exact quarterly aggregate Romania NPL ratio remains retained from ECB CBD2.
BNR official publications separately observe mortgage NPL, including 1.7 percent in September 2023 and March 2024, but no exact machine-readable mortgage NPL history is retained.

BNR housing-loan DSTI levels are observed in publication text for 2023-Q1..2025-Q2; outstanding-loan DSTI is conceptually closer to a mortgage NPL stock, but exact source-population/coverage/weighting compatibility is not demonstrated.
BNR DTI-O is debt-to-income at origination, not debt-service burden, and the June-2024 report states that the indicator covered about 25 percent of mortgage exposure value.
The aggregate NPL target has no matched aggregate debt-service burden.
A mortgage-specific target has not been preregistered and may not silently replace the aggregate target.
The output/activity observable remains unfrozen for either boundary.
Lag structure and treatment of NPL recognition, cures, write-offs, sales and regulatory/portfolio breaks remain unresolved.

mechanisms.next_admissible_action: Do not open 2018-2024 final evaluation and do not respecify the annual fiscal-reaction form on the same evidence cycle. Reopen only through a separately preregistered cycle justified by genuinely new measurement or identification evidence, such as a cyclically adjusted primary-balance vintage, longer real-time historical vintages, or an independently justified regime/identification design.
blockers: The preregistered lagged-state annual candidate failed structural selection before holdout.
Candidate RMSE was worse than naive primary-balance persistence over 2010-2017.
The preregistered non-negative output-gap coefficient domain failed at every expanding-origin fit.
The 2018-2024 final-evaluation window remains unopened and cannot be used to rescue or respecify this cycle.

mechanisms.next_admissible_action: Keep the policy rate observed/exogenous. Reopen only after retaining a machine-readable BNR financial-analyst expectations history indexed by survey formation date and a quarterly BNR GDP-gap vintage history mapped to the information set available at each policy decision. Then preregister managed-float/intervention treatment, policy-regime boundaries and simultaneity identification before any reaction-function fit. Do not digitise charts, use target-horizon-shifted expectation coordinates as formation dates, or backfill later revised gaps into earlier decisions.
blockers: BNR flat inflation target 2.5% ±1 pp and policy-rate history are observed.
DG ECFIN CONS_006 remains a qualitative response balance and is not percentage inflation expectations.
BNR publications confirm quantitative financial-analyst inflation expectations at 1-year and 2-year horizons in percent, but no immutable machine-readable formation-date history has been retained.

Historical BNR analyst-expectations charts may plot observations at the horizon to which they refer rather than at survey formation date; this mapping cannot be used directly in a policy-information set.
BNR Inflation Reports publish a quarterly model-based GDP gap and expose report information cutoffs, but no retained real-time vintage history has been materialized.
The BNR GDP-gap path is revised between forecast rounds, so later revised values may not be treated as if known at earlier policy decisions.
Managed-float intervention, policy-regime changes and simultaneous policy responses remain untreated.

mechanisms.next_admissible_action: Reopen only on a new official source capable of identifying joint sector × currency × residual-maturity/refinancing exposure or sector hedging. Do not repeatedly combine existing marginal sources.
blockers: ECB BPS identifies sector and original maturity but retains currency denominator All currencies.
BNR publishes aggregate external-debt currency composition, not a joint sector-by-currency matrix.
MoF publishes S13 currency-risk and one-year refinancing margins, but not the joint currency-by-principal-due schedule with matched old/new rates.
IMF reserve-template residual-maturity data apply to central-bank foreign-currency liquidity positions, not the broader external-debt sectors.
Sector hedging remains unobserved.

priority_rule: Priority is determined by the shortest scientifically admissible path to new independent evidence, not by a desire to activate a feedback loop. Waiting mechanisms remain frozen; source-incomplete mechanisms are not fit with proxies.

current_next_step.reason: Cross-registry mechanism readiness is now consolidated and executable in Scientific CI. All non-rejected behavioural mechanisms are either frozen after preregistered failure, waiting for prospective identifying events, or blocked by explicit source/measurement/identification triggers. No new empirical cycle should open merely because the queue is exhausted.

coverage_rule.rule: Every mechanism whose registry classification is CANDIDATE, DEFERRED or ACTIVATED must have exactly one source-readiness entry. REJECTED shortcuts are excluded because they have no admissible estimation path unless separately reopened.
